title: 第13章 带走公主第14章 前尘往事
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 裴苏眉头挑了挑，声音骤然温和起来。
“前朝公主殿下，不知······如何称呼？”
少女似乎被裴苏时而彬彬有礼，时而咄咄逼人搞昏了头，只道：“姜岁柠。”
裴苏眼神戏谑地在姜岁柠与躺在地上的青年身上流转了一下，道：
“这人甘为公主脱罪，公主甘为这人落泪，莫非是……情系之人？”
姜岁柠脸上泪痕未干，立即道：
“你不要胡说！只是错在我身，却由他人顶罪，我...无法接受。”
姜岁柠说到此处，又有些哽咽，但她又无法指责裴苏，因为此事是灵婆婆还有其他沉默者共同铸就的。
裴苏轻“哦”了一声，随即走到了那位生机尚未死绝的青年身旁，随意落下一枚药丸。
“服下，或许还能留一条残命……”
立马有几人慌慌张张地上前将染血青年给抬走。
少主这是……在干嘛？
其身后，黑袍老者有些傻眼。
连大晋朝那几位皇室公主、古阀中的嫡系贵女都断不会让少主如此，难道少主又有了什么谋划？
裴苏说完，又将目光放在了姜岁柠的脸上。
“北侯世子，你想做什么？”
老妇人沉着脸上前，一字一顿，眼睛更是死死盯着裴苏。
“很简单，”裴苏上前两步，淡淡道，“在捉住嫌犯之前，还请这位公主暂且跟着我……”
“呵！你莫要说笑，北侯世子。”
“我可没说笑。”
“殿下，退后些。”老妇人声音低沉，她发现裴苏上前后与姜岁柠只余两步之距。
姜岁柠恍惚，刚要往后退去，却不料裴苏忽然伸手抓住了姜岁柠的手腕。
“放肆！”
瞬间老妇人暴起，再管不得裴苏背景。
“找死！”
又是一声低斥，所有人眼里只觉一道黑影掠进视野，随即灵婆婆就倒飞出去。
所有人大叫起来，姜岁柠很是害怕地望了一眼裴苏，始终挣脱不开，只得颤声——
“北侯世子……你不要伤灵婆婆，不要迁怒别人……”
“咳咳！”

Pei Su raised his eyebrows and his voice suddenly became gentle.
"Your Highness, the former princess, I don't know...how to call her?"
The girl seemed to be confused by Pei Su's sometimes polite and sometimes aggressive behavior, so she only said: "Jiang Sui Ning."
Pei Su's eyes moved playfully on Jiang Suining and the young man lying on the ground, and said:
"This man is willing to absolve the princess, and the princess is willing to shed tears for this man. Could it be that he is... a person of love?"
The tears on Jiang Suining's face were not yet dry, and she immediately said:
"Don't talk nonsense! It's just my fault, but someone else takes the blame. I...can't accept it."
When Jiang Suining said this, she choked up a little, but she couldn't blame Pei Su, because this matter was caused by Granny Ling and other silent people.
Pei Suqing said "Oh", then walked to the young man who was still alive, and dropped a pill at random.
"If you take it, you might still be able to survive..."
Immediately, several people rushed forward in a panic and carried the blood-stained young man away.
Young Master, what is...doing?
Behind him, the old man in black robe was dumbfounded.
Even the royal princesses of the Jin Dynasty and the direct noble daughters of the ancient clan would never let the young master do this. Could it be that the young master has any other plans?
After Pei Su finished speaking, he focused his gaze on Jiang Suining's face.
"Prince Beihou, what do you want to do?"
The old woman stepped forward with a stern face, speaking every word, and her eyes were fixed on Pei Su.
"It's very simple," Pei Su took two steps forward and said calmly, "Until I catch the suspect, I ask this princess to follow me for the time being..."
"Ha! Don't make fun of me, Prince Beihou."
"I'm not kidding."
"Your Highness, stand back." The old woman's voice was low. She found that Pei Su was only two steps away from Jiang Suining.
Jiang Suining was in a daze and was about to step back, but Pei Su suddenly reached out and grabbed Jiang Suining's wrist.
"Presumptuous!"
In an instant, the old woman became angry and could no longer care about Pei Su's background.
"Seeking death!"
There was another low scolding, and everyone felt a black shadow flash into their field of vision, and then Granny Ling flew out.
"Grandma Ling!!!"
Everyone shouted, Jiang Suining glanced at Pei Su in fear, unable to break away, and could only tremble--
"Prince Beihou... don't hurt Granny Ling, don't make others angry..."
"Ahem!"
